response.text:
I can do that — but because removing or deleting email is destructive I need a couple quick clarifications before I act.

1) What should I do to matching messages?
   - Archive (remove from Inbox but keep in Mail)
   - Move to Trash (they’ll be removed from Inbox and go to Trash; Trash auto-deletes after ~30 days)
   - Permanently delete now (irreversible — I’ll avoid doing this unless you explicitly request it)

2) Which messages exactly?
   - All messages from noreply@transitalerts.net
   - Only messages older than N days (e.g., 30, 90)
   - Only messages before a specific date (e.g., before 2025-01-01)
   - Only read/unread, or all

3) Do you want a preview first? I can run a search and report how many matching messages I find (so you can confirm), before I perform the chosen action.

Tell me your choices for (1) and (2), and whether you want a preview. Once you confirm I’ll proceed.
